context: A boss and his manager debate a global affairs briefing memo
purpose: Teach: 因果/国交/アスベスト/ウィルス/参戦/周期/モダン/効用

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: このグローバル情勢のメモだが、因果関係の分析が浅すぎるんじゃないか?
lines.en: About this global affairs memo — isn't the causal analysis too shallow?
lines.style: Boss speaks bluntly with critical authority and formal workplace tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 申し訳ありません。国交断絶のリスクに焦点を当てすぎて、経済面が薄くなりました。
lines.en: I apologize. I focused too much on diplomatic rupture risks, so the economic angle got thin.
lines.style: Manager apologizes politely with professional self-critical humility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それに、海外工場のアスベスト問題と新型ウィルスの拡散を同じ章に並べるのは違和感がある。
lines.en: Also, lining up the overseas factory's asbestos problem with the new virus spread in the same chapter feels off.
lines.style: Boss critiques structure with sharp logical precision and impatience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そこは、両方とも越境リスクの章にまとめて押し込んでしまいました。構成を分けます。
lines.en: I crammed both of them together into the cross-border risk chapter. I'll separate the structure.
lines.style: Manager admits structural mistake with rueful honesty and resignation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 金融危機が約十年周期で来るという主張も、もっとモダンな統計モデルで裏付けないと弱いぞ。
lines.en: The claim that financial crises come roughly every ten years also needs backing with more modern statistical models, otherwise it's weak.
lines.style: Boss demands rigor with seasoned executive skepticism and directness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ごもっともです。各シナリオの期待効用を比較する表も追加いたします。
lines.en: Quite right. I'll also add a table comparing the expected utility of each scenario.
lines.style: Manager accepts feedback gracefully with deferential professional commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: あと、新興国が次々と関税戦争に参戦している件にも一節割いてくれ。
lines.en: Also, devote a section to how emerging countries are joining the tariff war one after another.
lines.style: Boss adds requirement with strategic foresight and managerial decisiveness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。結論を一枚にまとめた要約も付けて、今夜中にお持ちします。
lines.en: Understood. I'll attach a one-page summary of the conclusions and bring it to you tonight.
lines.style: Manager confirms order with crisp formal acknowledgment and resolve.
